nights.title: DragonForce: Inhuman Rampage 20th Anniversary
nights.name: DragonForce
nights.extract: DragonForce are a British power metal band from London, formed in 1999. They are known for their long and fast guitar solos, fantasy-themed lyrics and retro video game-influenced sound. The band themselves refer to their music as "extreme power metal".
